title: Witch-hunting will be the reason AI art tags on games goes away
author: Aineisa
selftext:
Seeing this more and more often where devs like the on in the linked post who didn’t use AI still get harassed by witch hunters. 

The end result will be that no one will believe these AI witch-hunters and everyone will not tag their work as AI assisted.

comments.body:

comments.body: I think we transition more into AI implementing watermarking. Since there is already an increase in the amount of LLMs and AI companies implementing watermarking.

comments.author: imnotabot303
comments.body:
The opposite will happen. Platforms will eventually be forced to make sure AI use is disclosed because it's a consumer focussed thing.

Your views on AI do not matter. Consumers have the right to choose.

Just as you would like to know if your product was hand made by artisans or created in a factory in China.
